name: Universal Scientific Industrial (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Universal Scientific Industrial (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a premier global provider of electronic design and manufacturing services (EMS). The company delivers a comprehensive suite of services, spanning product conceptualization, miniaturization expertise, meticulous material sourcing, advanced manufacturing, efficient logistics, worldwide sales, and thorough after-sales support for electronic devices and modules. Its extensive product lineup includes wireless connectivity components like Wi-Fi modules, alongside bespoke design and manufacturing (ODM/JDM/EMS) solutions for high-performance computing devices, servers, storage units, NAS systems, and solid-state drives. USI also specializes in printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) for diverse display technologies applied across consumer, computing, commercial, and automotive sectors. Furthermore, the company develops integrated solutions leveraging WLAN/WWAN capabilities for human-machine interfaces, smart home systems, and unmanned aerial vehicles. It supplies electronic components for imaging diagnostic equipment and complete systems for personal care, at-home medical monitoring, and remote healthcare. USI's offerings extend to wearable technology, featuring optical heart rate modules, smart wristbands, hybrid watches, PCBA/module products, and true wireless stereo Bluetooth earbud modules. The portfolio also encompasses power management components such as IGBT modules, IPMs, DC/DC converters, RF power transistors, optical transceivers, and modulator drivers, in addition to vehicular components and various information and communication products. Catering to a broad spectrum of industries, Universal Scientific Industrial serves sectors including wireless communication, data processing and storage, consumer electronics, industrial applications, and automotive electronics. Established in 2003 and headquartered in Shanghai, People's Republic of China, the company operates as a subsidiary of USI Enterprise Limited.
